contacto.faqDescription: Clear answers about buying at trino.
contacto.faqOrderQ: How can I follow my order?
contacto.faqOrderA: Order updates appear in your account. If you need help, pick the orders topic above.
contacto.faqDeliveryA: Delivery times are shown before you confirm your purchase and depend on your location.
contacto.faqChangesA: Check the changes and returns page for the current conditions.
contacto.faqWholesaleA: Use the collaborations topic to ask about the options available right now.
contacto.faqToneQ: How do I choose a shade?
contacto.faqToneA: Read the product descriptions and compare the available shades before you decide.
contacto.ctaBody: Explore the catalog or revisit the answers above whenever you need.
